title: Simple Crop Harvester
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that lets players right-click mature crops to harvest and automatically replant nearby crops.
body:
# Simple Crop Harvester

**Simple Crop Harvester** is a lightweight Fabric mod that makes farming faster and easier.

Instead of breaking and replanting crops one by one, you can simply **right-click a fully grown crop** to harvest it. The mod will also harvest a few nearby mature crops and automatically replant them if you have the correct seeds or replant items in your inventory.

## Features

* Right-click mature crops to harvest them
* Harvests the clicked crop and up to **3 nearby mature crops**
* Automatically replants crops if you have the correct seed/item
* Works with wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, and nether wart
* Does nothing to crops that are not fully grown
* Lightweight and simple to use
* Works in singleplayer
* Works server-side on multiplayer servers

## How to use

1. Install **Fabric Loader**
2. Install **Fabric API**
3. Put **Simple Crop Harvester** in your `mods` folder
4. Join a world or server
5. Right-click a fully grown crop
6. The crop will harvest and replant automatically if you have the correct item

## Supported crops

* Wheat
* Carrots
* Potatoes
* Beetroot
* Nether Wart

## Replant items

* Wheat uses **Wheat Seeds**
* Carrots use **Carrots**
* Potatoes use **Potatoes**
* Beetroot uses **Beetroot Seeds**
* Nether Wart uses **Nether Wart**

## Multiplayer

For multiplayer servers, this mod only needs to be installed on the **server**.

Players do not need to install it on their client to use the farming features on a server.

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Minecraft 26.1.x
* Java 25

## Future plans

Possible future updates may include:

* Configurable harvest range
* Toggleable replanting
* Support for more crops
* Modded crop support
* Optional cooldowns
* Config file support
